mapper.sql: SELECT c.comment_id, c.comment_post_id, c.comment_sent_user_id, su.user_nickname AS sent_user_nickname, c.comment_father_id, c.comment_receive_user_id, ru.user_nickname AS receive_user_nickname, c.comment_text, c.create_time FROM ch_post_comment c LEFT JOIN ch_user su ON su.user_id = c.comment_sent_user_id AND su.user_is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ch_user ru ON ru.user_id = c.comment_receive_user_id AND ru.user_is_delete = 0 WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.comment_is_delete = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ch_post_comment WHERE comment_post_id = #{postId} AND comment_father_id = 0 AND comment_is_delete = 0
